_about: Grounded science fiction: frontiers, scarce resources, hard choices. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

frontier: a terraforming camp on a red desert
a survey ship far from home
an orbital dock above a dying world
hazard: a dust storm that lasts weeks
an AI that is quietly failing
faction: the company that owns the debt
wrinkle: the colony charter is a fraud
the signal is a distress call from the future
the AI is lying to protect them
one crew member is a stowaway

cliches: the alien is the real victim
